notes:
See letter from Rev. L. Koss with chart of the Hemmerling family attached. Julius and Martha lived at 1457 Harmont Ave for at least from 1923 through 1940. Martha arrived in the USA on May 19, 1921 on the SS New Rochelle. See Rev. L. Koss letter Feb.27/98. Some conflict with Marthas' birthdate and surname spelling. I used dates on Stark County Cemetery inscriptions. Bertha Haemmerling is Martha's Sister.

On the SGGEE website for the St. Petersburg records, there is a record of a Martha Louise Haemmerling, Born March 9, 1877 at Gross Hluscha, Father is Carl H. and Mother is Amalie Frank. The LDS film # is 1895625/1, Page 714. This is undoubtedly the same person.

-Allan Zelmer
